name: Vertcoin
classificationNote: Upstream label "Key Compromise / Validator Key Compromised" on a base-layer chain: reclassified as a 51%/consensus attack.
rootCause: The chief maintainer of Vertcoin James Lovejoy revealed in an attack report on December 2 that a malicious entity targeted the cryptocurrency exchange Bittrex to manipulate the Vertcoin blockchain. The hacker paid at least $440 to attack VTC, but fortunately Vertcoin was not affected.

descriptions.text: The chief maintainer of Vertcoin James Lovejoy revealed in an attack report on December 2 that a malicious entity targeted the cryptocurrency exchange Bittrex to manipulate the Vertcoin blockchain. The hacker paid at least $440 to attack VTC, but fortunately Vertcoin was not affected.

Vertcoin suffered a 51% proof-of-work reorganization on 2019-12-01 that reportedly replaced 603 blocks, invalidated five transactions, and redirected about 125 VTC worth roughly $29. An attacker appears to have rented enough Lyra2REv3 hashpower to mine a heavier private fork, which Vertcoin's proof-of-work consensus accepted and which invalidated five earlier spends. The exact source of the hashpower remains unproven.
